latest_update: Published the current Noether record as 10.5281/zenodo.20822123. The latest public surface carries the R120/R121/R122 reader/source-audit material, the four targeted R122 source-audit webdrops first published in 20821409, Noether_R122_20260623.zip as a consolidated German R122 source-queue/cumulative working package, and Noether_Slavic_ZenodoDrive_Transfer_CurrentSources_20260623T1920Z.zip as a Ukrainian/Russian/Interslavic source-transfer package, plus Noether_R122_P10_P12_Reconcile_WebDrop_20260624.zip and Noether_R122_SourceFix_Rollup_P12_P13_P16_P20_WebDrop_20260624.zip as compact targeted R122 source-fix candidates. R122 reports Papers 32-33 source-audit work closed in that branch and leaves Paper 34 as the next high-fidelity sequential target. The Slavic package is working translation/source-transfer provenance and needs reconciliation against the current German source-audit queue before canonical multilingual promotion. RA25-RA34 remain the current Paper 02 source-audit correction stream; RA29 closes the Paper 02 body through printed pp.84-90 at the current page-level standard, RA31 source-checks Tabelle I on printed/source p.91, and RA33/RA34 source-check Tabelle II p.92 rows 0-23 at plate-row level. The new P10/P12 and P12/P13/P16/P20 rollups are targeted source-fix candidates only; they do not certify whole papers and do not imply downstream language propagation. This is working/source-audit/provenance material only, not a critical edition, not whole-corpus mathematical certification, and not multilingual propagation.
